name: John Egbert
source:
John Egbert is one of the main characters in Homestuck. While originally given the name "Zoosmell Pooplord", the game rejected it and settled for John.

The story begins on John's 13th birthday as he awaits the arrival of an upcoming game in the mail.

[Partially from [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/John_Egbert]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
